why_here: This is a DENY-LISTED extension (.json) under a NESTED 'docs' directory. roborev v0.61.2's git.FormatExcludeArgs passes a pattern containing an interior '/' VERBATIM, so 'docs/**/*.json' is ROOT-ANCHORED at the repository's own docs/ and CANNOT match this path.
